title: Leonida Roadmap Planner
listNote: All 55 official trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment every other trophy on this list is earned — there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in stage order: story first, then the one-chance moments, then cleanup and the long grinds. The description itself names no extra step, so the platinum is purely a record of having done everything else.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story, so it comes to you naturally if you play the opening through. The description names no chapter beyond that mission itself, and gives no location or step to hunt for — just play the opening mission to its end. Flagged missable: finish it on your first run through the opening, before the story moves on.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 in full. Every mission in the chapter counts toward it, so keep playing the story until the chapter closes. The description does not name the chapter's missions one by one, so there is no shortcut list to check off — the chapter trophy pops when the last mission of the chapter ends. Flagged missable: finish the chapter's business before the story moves into Chapter 2.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. Play every mission of the second chapter until the chapter closes. The description names no individual mission, so the only reliable plan is to keep the story moving and not leave the chapter's missions unfinished. Flagged missable: wrap up Chapter 2 before Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full — the chapter where Vice City opens up. Finish each mission of the chapter until it closes. The description lists no mission names, so follow the story and let the chapter run its course. Flagged missable: finish the chapter before the story moves on to Chapter 4.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full, the last full chapter before the finale. Play the chapter's missions through to its close. The description names no single mission, so the trophy is simply the chapter's closing mark. Flagged missable: finish Chapter 4 before the final mission unlocks.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks after Chapter 4, so keep the story moving until the last mission appears, then finish it. The description names the mission only as the final mission — no title or place is given — so there is nothing to look up ahead of time. Flagged missable: this is the point of no return for the whole story, so finish any flagged chapter or mission trophy before you start it.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. It appears as you play through the story, so keep following the missions until Breakfast Run shows up, then finish it. The description gives no chapter, place or step beyond the mission's name, so there is nothing else to prepare. Flagged missable: do Breakfast Run the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the story until the heist mission appears, then see it through. The description names no chapter or location for it, so the plan is simply to reach it in the story and finish it. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story until Child's Play appears, then finish it. The description gives no chapter, place or step beyond the mission's name. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. It comes up in the story's flow, so keep the missions moving until Headliners appears, then finish it. The description names no chapter or place for it. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the story until the takedown at VCIA appears, then finish it. The description names no chapter or step beyond the mission itself. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. Keep the story moving until the operation appears, then finish it. The description names no chapter or place beyond the mission's name. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across the whole game. That means the story, the collectibles, the activities and the side content all done — this trophy is the last cleanup check, so leave it for stage 8, after the story and the one-chance moments. The description does not spell out what counts toward the 100%, so track it in the game's own completion counter and mop up whatever category is still short. Not missable: it can be finished at any point after the story, in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts build up through jumps, airtime and driving feats in the open world, so this is a long grind best left for stage 9, after the story. The description does not say which moves count as a stunt or where to do them, so keep an eye on the counter as you play and keep attempting jumps and air tricks until it reaches 250. Not missable: the counter keeps counting in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. That means sampling every activity the open world offers — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest — one go at each. The description does not list the activity types, so the practical way is to open each activity you come across and try it at least once, checking the list as you go. Not missable: activities stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them, as PlayStation tracks the count. Visit the shooting range and work through every challenge until each one holds a gold medal. The description does not say where the range is or how each challenge is scored, so expect to replay challenges until the gold standard is met. Not missable: the range stays open after the story.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race location, enter the race there and win it. The description does not list how many locations there are or where they sit, so check each race site as you find it and keep a note of the ones already won. Not missable: drone races stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida and win twenty distinct ones — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. The description does not name the races or their places, so work through the race list across the map and keep count of the ones already won. Not missable: races stay open after the story.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, take it on and out-fish him. The description names the rival but no place, time or winning score, so treat it as a one-off duel to seek out when fishing opens up. Nothing in the description marks it as a single attempt, so nothing here calls it missable.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start a game and play it through to its end. The description does not say which arcade game or where the machines are, so any completed arcade game should count — try the first machine you find. Not missable: arcade games stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through the story, so follow his missions until the last one appears, then finish it. The description names no mission title, chapter or place — only the character — so keep an eye on Andy's strand as the story moves. Flagged missable: finish Andy's last mission before his strand closes.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand through the story until its last mission appears, then finish it. The description gives no title, chapter or place for it, only the character. Flagged missable: finish it before Kenton's strand closes.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear around the map — take each strand and play it to its end, eight strands in total. The description does not name the strangers or their places, so explore the map and pick up every stranger mission you find. Nothing in the description marks it missable: no chapter or moment is named, so work through the strands whenever they appear.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the map — visit each one and meditate there. The description does not say how many spots there are or where they sit, so explore thoroughly and keep a note of the ones already visited. Not missable: spots stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — find it and take it down for him. The description names the animal only as unique, with no species, place or season given, so there is nothing to pin down ahead of time beyond watching for Bret's hunt. Flagged missable: do the hunt the first time Bret offers it, before the chance passes.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — gather full sets, three sets in total. The description does not say how many cards a set holds or where they hide, so collect every card you come across and check the sets as they fill. Not missable: cards stay findable in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots sit all over Leonida — find a hundred of them and use the WAiNK action at each. The description does not list the spots, so sweep the map area by area and keep count as you go. Not missable: the spots stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover the game's side goals — finish fifty of them across whatever categories the game tracks. The description does not name the challenges, so open the challenge list, pick the easiest ones first and work up to fifty. Not missable: challenges stay open after the story.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it deliberately: commit crimes with your partner in the car or on foot until you hit 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. Point of no return: your partner must be with you when it happens. Flagged missable: do it the first time the moment arises — do not assume a later replay will re-award it.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. Plan a route past three close shops, keep the heat on through all three robberies, and do not let the cops lose you mid-run. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over. Flagged missable: do it the first time the chance comes up.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count as discovered when you find them around Leonida — drive, explore and keep an eye out for new models. The description does not list the vehicles, so the practical plan is to explore widely and let the counter climb. Not missable: vehicles stay discoverable in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus during a fight and drop five enemies before it ends. The description names no place or fight, so pick a busy shootout, wait for a cluster of enemies and use the focus there. Not missable: Combat Focus can be used again in any later fight.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule never planned — the description's joke is the whole clue, and it names no aircraft, gate or step. Watch for the moment at the airport and take it when it shows up. Flagged missable: do it the first time the chance appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke about Rhino tanks and gives no step, place or number at all — no target to hit or count to reach is named. Something involving a Rhino tank is the heart of it, but where and how is not pinned down by the description. Flagged missable: take the chance the first time a Rhino moment appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the goods while staying unseen — no alarms, no spotting. The description names no store or approach, so plan a quiet entry, avoid the sightlines and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Nothing in the description marks it as a one-time chance.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. The description does not name the banks or the vaults, so work through the vault robberies as you find them and keep count. Not missable: vault robberies stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, hit it and get away. The description names no truck, route or time — armored trucks run their routes around Leonida, so watch for one, strike, then lose the heat. Flagged missable: do it the first time a truck appears in your path.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map — every area, town and stretch of road — until the map is fully revealed. The description does not list the areas, so drive and fly across the state and watch the explored share climb. Not missable: the map stays open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations — hit one belonging to each gang. The description does not name the gangs or their operations, so work through the gangs one by one and keep a note of which are done. Not missable: operations stay open in free roam.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view and enjoy a cocktail there. The description names the beach but no bar, time or exact spot, so look for the cocktail moment once you are on Ocean Beach. Flagged missable: do it the first time the moment appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a vehicle showroom and break out through it — the classic smash-and-grab exit the description hints at. No showroom, vehicle or route is named, so take the chance when a showroom moment presents itself. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl there. The description names the alley but no score, lane or step, so head there and play a round when the chance comes. Flagged missable: do it the first time it appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is a riddle and names no activity, place or number — a partnership doing something with mass appeal is the whole clue. No step can be pinned down from the description alone, so watch for a moment with your partner that fits the wording. Flagged missable: do it the first time the moment appears.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The description is deliberately vague — choices, made, for better or worse — and names no place or step. PlayStation tracks a count of 500 against it, so whatever the choice is, it is something done hundreds of times across the game; the description alone does not say what the choice is. Flagged missable: make the choice the first time it is offered, before the moment passes.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles, with the tracked count from PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is a joke about a second attempt and names no activity, place or step. Something that takes two tries is the heart of it — the description alone does not say what. Flagged missable: when the moment comes around a second time, take it.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

No step can be pinned down from the description alone. Flagged missable: be ready when the strange moment shows up; it may not come twice.
trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive by and knock them over with a melee attack — bowling, but from a moving vehicle. trophies.source: Source: the official PlayStation trophy list as published via Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide is written from the official description alone.

Not missable: properties stay buyable in free roam.
